phase: Ads live · day 5 — real pace is ~$15/day, not $40
headline: The “$40/day” was an extrapolation off one mid-morning number — and the full day disagreed. Aug 22 closed at $15.11 by 4:36 PM PT: real delivery, 1,246 impressions, CPL $0.40, frequency 1.05, every kill gate clear — but a ~$15/day burn, not $40. That is not a failure, it is a different calendar: the ~$150–200 sample floor is now roughly nine days out, not three. The slower burn just handed you the time to wire the CRM before the numbers start mattering. Spend it on that.
source: Aug 22 PM brief + live FA-ADS watchdog full-day read (Aug 22 16:36 PT / 23:38Z) + inbox sweep + scheduler API · Aug 23

spotlight.title: Re-date the decision: at ~$15/day the verdict is ~Aug 31, not this week
spotlight.detail: Yesterday’s brief read $8.51 at 6:35 AM PT and projected the full $40/day. The rest of the day settled it: $10.36 (10:35), $12.19 (13:35), $14.08 (15:36), $15.11 (16:36) — about $0.66/hour, closing near $16. So Aug 22 spent roughly $15, not $40. Everything else is genuinely healthy: 1,246 impressions, CPL $0.40, frequency 1.05, all six ads ACTIVE, zero rejections, zero delivery-blocking errors, R1/R2/R3 all untriggered. The consequence is calendar, not quality — at ~$15/day the ~$150–200 sample floor arrives around Aug 31 rather than mid-week, and the $650 balance stretches ~40 days instead of ~16. Stop reading each morning’s spend as a verdict. One reconciliation flag, not smoothed over: the watchdog printed “campaign-to-date $24.87” alongside “today $15.11”, which does not square with Saturday mid-morning’s “$24.68 over 3 days” — treat the to-date figure as a reporting-window question to resolve in Ads Manager, and trust the daily numbers.

spotlight.title: Wire a CRM / booking source — you just bought ~9 days to do it
spotlight.detail: Still the top gap, and now the timing argument is decisive. Cost per booked call is the metric the whole test exists to find, and it is un-computable: the watchdog reported “no CRM source connected” for both booked calls and cost per booked call again last night. The slower burn means the sample will not be decision-grade until roughly Aug 31 — that is the window to instrument the funnel, not a reason to wait. If it is still unwired when spend crosses $150, the review at $150 will be exactly as blind as the review at $25. Pair it with Vercel Analytics (w10, 18 days owed), the pre-spend gate the launch skipped: real money is buying traffic and nothing on our side is counting it.

spotlight.detail: Unchanged and now five days old on money that is actually moving: NPN + CA producer license number + a not-guaranteed / rates-vary disclaimer on every one of the six live creatives and on the landing page. This is the one item where the slower pace buys nothing — exposure is per-impression, and 2,196 impressions have already run. The predecessor account was banned for precisely this omission. Frankie supplies the numbers, Chitraksh places them; it is a same-day task the moment the numbers exist.
